description: Defines how to read a bank statement Excel file: which row has headers, which columns contain date/amount/description, and how to parse dates and numbers. Pre-configured for BIDV, MB Bank, Sacombank, PG Bank. Create a new format for other banks.

fields.label: Format Name
fields.description: A descriptive name, e.g. 'BIDV - Sao kê TK' or 'MB Bank - Bang ket qua giao dich'

fields.label: Bank
fields.description: The bank this format belongs to. Used for auto-detection when uploading.

fields.label: File Type
fields.description: File extension of the bank export. PG Bank uses .xls (actually HTML inside).

fields.label: Sheet Index
fields.description: 0 = first sheet. Most banks use the first sheet.

fields.label: Header Row
fields.description: Row number (1-indexed) containing column headers. Open the file in Excel to find it. BIDV uses row 16.

fields.label: Data Start Row
fields.description: Row number where actual transaction data begins (after header). BIDV uses row 18 (dual-row header).

fields.label: Column Mapping
fields.description: Map each field to a column in the Excel file. Use a single letter (A, B, C...) for column position, or type the header text for text-based matching.

fields.label: Date Column
fields.description: Column letter (e.g. 'A') or header text. This column contains the transaction date.

fields.label: Narration Column
fields.description: Column with transaction description/narration. Used for matching with invoices.

fields.label: Debit (Withdrawal) Column
fields.description: Column for money going out. Some banks use separate debit/credit columns, others use a single amount column.

fields.label: Balance Column
fields.description: Column showing running balance (optional, not used for matching).

fields.label: Reference Column
fields.description: Transaction reference number from the bank. Helps with deduplication on re-upload.

fields.label: Counter Account No Column
fields.description: Counterparty bank account number (optional). Helps identify the party.

fields.label: Counter Account Name Column
fields.description: Counterparty name (optional). Used by the name-matching engine.

fields.label: Parsing Rules
fields.description: How to interpret date and number formats in the file.

fields.label: Decimal Separator
fields.description: Character for decimal point. VN banks typically use '.' (dot).

fields.label: Thousands Separator
fields.description: Character separating thousands. VN banks typically use ',' (comma).

name: Bank Statement Format
